feeds.title: spielverlagerung.com
feeds.description: Spielverlagerung is a football website with a heavy tactical emphasis. Our in-depth analysis delivers unique insight for fans, players, coaches, analysts & journalists.

feeds.title: Holding Midfield
feeds.description: Holding Midfield was founded by Joshua Askew, a football coach, as a means of keeping track of his thoughts and feelings on what's going on in football. He used to make notes on matches so these should just be seen as a more coherent form of them, which hopefully some will find interesting.

feeds.title: The Mastermind Site
feeds.description: The Mastermind Site is a football tactic and analysis website, dedicated to helping all football fanatics develop a greater understanding of the technical, tactical, and mental aspects of the beautiful game.

feeds.title: The False 9
feeds.description: The False 9 is a leading website on Football tactics and strategy. It covers a range of contents related to the history of football and football tactics for beginners including; the football match which started a war, total football and its impact on the modern game, and a history of Sheffield Wednesday.

feeds.title: Breaking The Lines
feeds.description: Breaking The Lines is a football content creation service that provides users with tools and applications to create self-crafted, curated, football-related media. Content created on Breaking The Lines can range anything from long-form journalism, original reporting, in-depth analysis, video analysis, and graphic media.

feeds.title: Total Football Analysis
feeds.description: On Total Football Analysis Magazine, you will find everything you want from a football analysis site such as match analysis, player analysis, manager/head coach analysis, recruitment analysis, and set-piece analysis.

feeds.title: The Conventional Playmaker
feeds.description: The Conventional Playmaker focuses on writing about the tactics of football, with the odd diversion toward history and statistics. See topics such as; Liverpool's right versus Ajax's left, United needs a winger but needs to prioritize other areas first, Joelinton, and the hard-working midfielder.

feeds.title: Between The Posts
feeds.description: Every football match is a story in itself and we will tell you exactly those stories. Between the Posts focuses on tactics and will help you discover the storylines that define what happens on the pitch during a clash between two football teams. The daily match reports on Between the Posts provide the reader with tactical insights that will help to enjoy the beautiful game.

feeds.title: Café Tactiques
feeds.description: Café Tactiques is a website dedicated to the tactical and analytical side of football/soccer. Posts will include scouting reports on specific teams, match reports, discussions of managers' tactical philosophy, player and team data analysis, and anything else related to tactics or data within the beautiful game.

feeds.title: The Football Analyst
feeds.description: The Football Analyst provides aspiring players, coaches, and football enthusiasts with detailed breakdowns of the beautiful game, helping you better understand the strategies, nuances, and trends shaping modern football.

feeds.title: Diamond Football Tactics
feeds.description: A blog about football tactics, shapes, coaches and player profiles.

feeds.title: Tactics Journal
feeds.description: Analyzing football tactics by Kyle Boas.

feeds.title: Soccer Interaction Academy Blog
feeds.description: Learn with the Blog in english of the international soccer academy in Spain Soccer Interaction. Football training.

feeds.title: Coaches' Voice

feeds.title: Terrier Spirit » Tactics
feeds.description: A blog section offering tactical analysis, formations, and strategy insights focused on Huddersfield Town FC.

feeds.title: Suburban Gooners » Tactics

feeds.title: Strikerless » Tactics

feeds.title: TacticTalks » Tactics & Strategy
feeds.description: TacticTalks publishes in-depth tactical and strategic analysis of football — from training methods and player development to pressing styles and club-level strategy.

feeds.title: Opta Analyst
feeds.description: Opta Analyst is the home of data-driven storytelling. The best stats and predictions for football, NFL and NBA covered.

feeds.title: Guardian » Football Tactics
feeds.description: Get the latest football news, US news, world news, sports, business, opinion, analysis, and reviews from the Guardian, the world's leading liberal voice. The Guardian is one of the world's leading English-language newspaper websites, known for open journalism, digital innovation, branded content, media advertising, and publishing.

feeds.title: Football Blog » Football Tactics
feeds.description: Football Blog aims to provide you with cutting-edge analysis and opinion across the top European leagues, while also separating the fake news from the real stories. It covers a variety of topics including football tactics, player profiles, predictions, and match previews, in addition to deconstructing topical issues.

feeds.title: Running The Show
feeds.description: Running The Show was created as a way of spreading ideas, opinions, and observations of all things football. Over the years, we've written about tactics, coaching, player development, and recruitment, done interviews with people in the game as well as produced what we like to see as some really good storytelling. We try to cater to every fan, every coach, and every player, so you can always expect something that suits you.

feeds.title: Asymmetric
feeds.description: This site aims to promote discussion and thought around different perspectives and concepts in Football, whether that's through the medium of Football Manager or real-life events. Find writings on football, tactics, youth development, training, and many more.

feeds.title: The Coaches Voice
feeds.description: Find Football coaching insights and football coaching tips from leading football coaches. The Coaches' Voice is an online platform where the world's best football coaches and managers can discuss their coaching philosophies and share experiences from their journeys in the game so far.
